Lauren / team — I pulled AR aging and the cash application logs. Summary:
- Lockbox posted payment 02/09/2026 ref PAY-ACME-0226 for $148,320 to INV-2025-9921.
- INV-2025-9921 is a credit memo (issued 2025-12-28) for -$49,800 that should have reduced the three invoices, not been closed by cash application.
- The remaining $98,520 corresponds to the three invoices mentioned but the system tied everything to the credit memo due to matching rule priority.

Proposed steps:
1) Reverse the cash application for INV-2025-9921 (manual unapplied cash entry).
2) Apply $98,520 across INV-9898/9902/9907 per remittance.
3) Create accounting journal to reclassify the $49,800 credit memo impact back to deferred/credit balance and adjust revenue recognition if any revenue was recognized against that credit memo in Jan 2026.

I attached the raw application extract and a draft journal template. Will need Michael to confirm the GL accounts and Rishi to sign off if revenue recognition policy is affected.

Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the extract. Proposed journal (to be posted 2026-02-18):
- JE1 (reverse incorrect application): Debit Cash 148,320; Credit AR 148,320 (to remove the lockbox application from INV-9921)
- JE2 (reapply payments): Debit AR 98,520; Credit Cash 98,520 (apply to INV-9898/9902/9907)
- JE3 (reclass credit memo effect): Debit Revenue 49,800; Credit Deferred Revenue (or Credit Memo clearing) 49,800 — this assumes revenue was booked against the credit memo in Jan; if revenue not recognized, entry will instead clear AR/credit memo balance.

I recommend posting JE1/J E2 as reversing pairs so month-end reporting stays clean. For JE3, we need confirmation whether revenue was recognized — Rishi, can you confirm any GAAP/ASC implications and sign off? Also copying Monica for ELT visibility — this affects ARR/recognized revenue for January.

I'll attach the journal CSV for upload and the GL mapping.
